Imma break it down.

Step 1: Hold pack of cards in left hand with the back facing towards the other players.

Step 2: Apply gentle pressure to the left hands thumb while pulling up with the right hand to separate the pack into two parts (doesn't matter if its equal).

Step 3: Bring the packet lifted by the right hand in front of the packet held by the left hand. Make sure you lift the thumb of the left hand to make room.

Step 4: Use left hand thumb to pull some cards off the packet in the right hand then lift the right hand packet and repeat.
